title: Univertify
tagline: Providing NFT Liquidity with fractionalize. It adjust liquidity based on the amount of fractionalize
description: By using uniswap, it provides NFT liquidity with fractionalize. Once NFT received, it mint a new position, and it can increase or decrease liquidity based on the amount of fractionalize. But, currently, not fully implemented it. so keep working on this. Also, on later will connect to client ui as well.
